_comment:
'**Lightning Flow** - If you've played a Lightning card this turn, this gets +1{p}.'

The Flow keyword itself is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored here (triage note: 'Flow fires from the DB keywords field, no authoring'). Note 'Lightning Flow' elsewhere in this corpus is an AURA TOKEN (json/tokens/lightning_flow.json) - unrelated to this keyword line; do not confuse them.

Release notes settle the ability type: 'Whether you've played a Lightning card this turn is checked while this is attacking on the combat chain' and a Lightning card played before damage calculation still counts - the condition is ALWAYS CHECKING during the attack, so this is a static re-evaluated on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER (WHILE_STATIC), not a triggered ON_ATTACK check frozen at declaration. This is the Aggressive Pounce lesson: always-checking means static.

Shape is shipped pen/savage_claw.json (the documented WHILE_STATIC power-conditional): conditions gate it, MODIFY_ATTACK add 1 lands in the stage-8 static window so it is never double-applied. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK keeps the buff on Crackling's own attack only.

The condition: play.py (~1085) records every played card's slug/name/types/subtypes/classes/TALENTS/colour as turn-event qualifiers via _record_turn_event (verified at play.py:1085-1101); EVENT_THIS_TURN folds its qualifier through _norm (strips non-alnum, lowercases), so qualifier 'lightning' matches any played card with the Lightning talent (condition_types.py:1070-1112).

Identical shape to sibling draft .drafts/crackling_yellow.json; red and yellow printings share the +1{p} amount.
